Local cheap buffet
Dec 2025 • Couples
You can enjoy seafood at low prices in a local atmosphere. Barbecues also have meat, but seafood is the thing that suits the Japanese. The grilled oysters are small but fresh, and you can go for as many as you want with the cheese sauce recommended by the staff. There are also local foods such as freshly baked banh seo. All-you-can-drink beer hoi and soft drinks. The dessert chee was also delicious. If you have the guts (?), why not try crocodiles, frogs, tanishi, etc.?
